Rio de Janeiro by night! — USD 250 per person
Price is for the show only.

An evening show celebrating Brazil’s culture and traditions, with samba and other Latin American dances. Brazilian rhythms, capoeira and colourful costumes bring the performance to life.

Transfers are not included and can be arranged on request at an additional cost.

blocks.text:
Guanabara Bay boat trip — USD 290 per person
Group boat trip for a minimum of 2 people, with an English-speaking guide.

Depart from Marina da Glória aboard a comfortable boat and enjoy views of one of Brazil’s largest and most beautiful bays. Sea breezes, blue water and the panoramas of Rio de Janeiro set the scene as you sail past Botafogo, Flamengo and Urca. From the water, admire Sugar Loaf, tropical islands, São João Fort and the Rio–Niterói Bridge.

You will also see the Museum of Contemporary Art designed by Oscar Niemeyer, the historic Santa Cruz Fortress built in the 16th century, and the city’s neighbourhoods spread across the hillsides.

Transfers are included.
